title: Scoop Manifest v0.1 (HUMMBL)
description: Expected schema for generated Scoop manifests in hummbl-dev/scoop-bucket. Manifests are downstream generated surfaces from hummbl-dev/packages.

version.description: Release version, sourced verbatim from the release artifact receipt.

architecture.description: Per-architecture artifact map. Keys are Scoop architecture identifiers (e.g. 64bit, 32bit, arm64).

url.description: Download URL(s) for the artifact. May be a single string or a per-architecture map. Sourced from the release artifact receipt.

hash.description: Checksum(s) for the artifact. May be a single string or a per-architecture map. Sourced from the release artifact receipt.

bin.description: Executable entry point(s) installed by the package. Sourced from the package identity registry.

checkver.description: Version-check definition used by Scoop. Sourced from the package identity registry.

autoupdate.description: Autoupdate definition used by Scoop. Sourced from the package identity registry.

license.description: SPDX license identifier or license URL. Sourced from the package identity registry.

homepage.description: Project homepage. Sourced from the package identity registry.

description.description: Short human-readable description. Sourced from the package identity registry.
